title: Add to Calendar
description: A core/button that adds the current event to the visitor's calendar, using the event's dates from Fair Events.

registration.detail: Fair Events adds the isCalendarButton attribute to core/button on every site. The editor offers the variation only while editing a post type enabled for events (fair_event by default).

minimal.title: Calendar button on an event post
minimal.description: A Buttons block holding one calendar button. Dates, title, link, and location come from the event.
